title: Drive
subtitle: drive = 駕駛；開車；乘車前往；駕車載送
description: drive = 駕駛；開車；乘車前往；駕車載送

words.note: 較正式，強調實際控制和操作汽車、貨車、巴士等車輛。
words.example: Employees must be licensed to operate a vehicle on company business.

exercises.original: Only trained staff may drive company vehicles on the construction site.
exercises.zh: 只有受過訓練的職員才可在工地駕駛公司車輛。
exercises.upgrade: operate · 駕駛車輛；操作車輛

options.explanation: 正式工地語境中，operate a vehicle 很自然。
表示乘坐，不代表控制車輛。
名詞，may 後需動詞原形。

exercises.original: You must hold the correct licence to drive this type of commercial vehicle.
exercises.zh: 你必須持有適當牌照才可駕駛這類商用車輛。
exercises.upgrade: operate · 駕駛車輛；操作車輛

options.explanation: licence + commercial vehicle 是正式車輛操作語境。

exercises.original: The manual explains how to drive the vehicle safely in icy conditions.
exercises.zh: 手冊說明如何在結冰路面安全駕駛車輛。
exercises.upgrade: operate · 駕駛車輛；操作車輛

options.explanation: manual + safely + vehicle 表示整體操作。

words.note: 重點不是駕駛技巧，而是「以汽車作交通方式」。
words.example: We usually travel by car when visiting relatives outside the city.

exercises.original: We usually drive when visiting relatives outside the city.
exercises.zh: 我們到市外探親時通常會乘車前往。
exercises.upgrade: travel by car · 乘車前往；駕車出行

exercises.original: They drove across the country instead of taking the train.
exercises.zh: 他們沒有乘火車，而是乘車橫跨全國。
exercises.upgrade: travelled by car · 乘車前往；駕車出行

options.explanation: instead of taking the train 明確比較交通方式。

exercises.original: Most visitors drive to the park because there is no direct bus service.
exercises.zh: 由於沒有直達巴士，大部分旅客都乘車前往公園。
exercises.upgrade: travel by car · 乘車前往；駕車出行

options.explanation: 巴士服務形成交通方式對比。
不清楚表示汽車交通方式。

words.note: 較傳統，尤其見於英式英語。常表示一般或悠閒地駕車前往某地。
words.example: They motored through the countryside before lunch.

exercises.original: They drove through the countryside before lunch.
exercises.zh: 他們午飯前駕車穿過鄉郊。
exercises.upgrade: motored · 駕車；乘汽車前往

options.explanation: 較傳統的 motor through 可表示駕車行經某地。

exercises.original: We drove along the coast and stopped at several small towns.
exercises.zh: 我們沿海岸駕車，途中在幾個小鎮停留。
exercises.upgrade: motored · 駕車；乘汽車前往

options.explanation: 沿海駕車旅行符合 motor 的傳統語感。

exercises.original: The couple drove north for several hours before reaching the lake.
exercises.zh: 這對伴侶向北駕車數小時後到達湖邊。
exercises.upgrade: motored · 駕車；乘汽車前往

options.explanation: 可表示一段以汽車完成的旅程。

words.note: 很自然的日常說法，直接表示以汽車作為交通方式。
words.example: It is easier to go by car because the station is far away.

exercises.original: It is easier to drive because the station is far away.
exercises.zh: 因為車站很遠，所以駕車前往比較方便。
exercises.upgrade: go by car · 乘車去；坐車前往

options.explanation: 日常地表示選擇汽車作交通方式。

exercises.original: Shall we drive or take the bus?
exercises.zh: 我們開車去還是乘巴士去？
exercises.upgrade: go by car · 乘車去；坐車前往

options.explanation: 和 take the bus 形成直接交通方式對比。

exercises.original: We normally drive to the supermarket when buying heavy items.
exercises.zh: 買重物時，我們通常會開車去超級市場。
exercises.upgrade: go by car · 乘車去；坐車前往

words.note: 表示在多種交通方式中選擇用汽車，尤其常和 walk、bus、train 等形成對比。
words.example: We decided to take the car because it was raining heavily.

exercises.original: We decided to drive because it was raining heavily.
exercises.zh: 因為下大雨，我們決定開車去。
exercises.upgrade: take the car · 開車去；選擇駕車

options.explanation: decided 表示選擇交通方式。

exercises.original: If the weather gets worse, we can drive instead of walking.
exercises.zh: 如果天氣轉差，我們可以開車而不是步行。
exercises.upgrade: take the car · 開車去；選擇駕車

options.explanation: instead of walking 明確比較交通方式。

exercises.original: She usually cycles, but today she drove because she had several boxes to carry.
exercises.zh: 她平日踩單車，但今天因為要帶幾箱東西，所以選擇開車。
exercises.upgrade: took the car · 開車去；選擇駕車

options.explanation: usually cycles, but today 顯示交通選擇改變。

words.note: 較口語，字面是「坐到方向盤後面」，引申為親自駕車。
words.example: She was nervous the first time she got behind the wheel.

exercises.original: She was nervous the first time she drove on her own.
exercises.zh: 她第一次獨自親自駕駛時感到緊張。
exercises.upgrade: got behind the wheel · 開始駕駛；親自開車

options.explanation: first time + on her own 強調親自開始駕駛。

exercises.original: After six months without driving, he finally drove again.
exercises.zh: 六個月沒有開車後，他終於再次親自駕駛。
exercises.upgrade: got behind the wheel · 開始駕駛；親自開車

options.explanation: 強調重新開始親自駕車。

exercises.original: He had never driven before starting his lessons.
exercises.zh: 開始學車前，他從未親自駕駛過。
exercises.upgrade: got behind the wheel · 開始駕駛；親自開車

options.explanation: 駕駛課前從未親自控制車輛。

words.note: 當 drive 的意思是「開車載某人去某地」時，chauffeur 可作較精確的替代，常帶專門接送意味。
words.example: He chauffeured the guests from the hotel to the venue.

exercises.original: He drove the guests from the hotel to the venue.
exercises.zh: 他駕車把賓客由酒店送到會場。
exercises.upgrade: chauffeured · 駕車接送；當司機載送

options.explanation: the guests from ... to ... 表示專門駕車載送他人。

exercises.original: She drove her elderly parents to every hospital appointment.
exercises.zh: 她每次都駕車接送年長父母去醫院覆診。
exercises.upgrade: chauffeured · 駕車接送；當司機載送

options.explanation: 重點是她反覆親自駕車接送父母。

exercises.original: A staff member drove the speakers between the airport and conference centre.
exercises.zh: 一名職員駕車接送講者往返機場和會議中心。
exercises.upgrade: chauffeured · 駕車接送；當司機載送

options.explanation: 機場和會議中心之間接送賓客，是 chauffeur 的典型語境。
句子需要過去式。 --- End of teaching material

falseSynonyms.zh: 乘車／騎乘不等於駕駛 ride 通常表示乘坐交通工具，或騎單車、馬等；若只是坐在汽車內而不是控制車輛，就不是 drive。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She drove the car while I rode in the passenger seat.

falseSynonyms.zh: 控制方向不等於完整駕駛 steer 只強調控制方向；drive 包含加速、煞車、觀察路面等整個駕駛行為。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You steer with the wheel, but you drive the whole vehicle.

falseSynonyms.zh: 通勤不等於所有 drive commute 是定期往返住所和工作／學習地點，可以乘車、搭火車、踩單車等，不一定開車。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She commutes by train, while her colleague drives to work.

falseSynonyms.zh: 導航不等於駕駛 navigate 是找路、規劃或判斷方向；可以由乘客負責。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON One person can drive while another navigates.

falseSynonyms.zh: 駕駛飛機／船隻不等於一般開車 pilot 主要用於飛機，也可用於某些船隻或專業操作；一般汽車不用 pilot。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A pilot flies an aircraft; a motorist drives a car.

falseSynonyms.zh: 泊車只是駕駛的一部分 park 指把車停在適當位置，是 drive 過程中的一個具體動作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She drove into town and parked near the library.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動詞和人物不同 drive 是動詞；driver 是駕駛者。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He can drive. He is a careful driver.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞形不同 drive 是動詞原形；driving 可作動名詞、現在分詞或形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They drive to work. Driving in heavy rain requires extra care.
